pre_planning_concepts.name: Pre-Need Funeral Planning vs. At-Need Funeral Arrangements
pre_planning_concepts.summary: Pre-need planning involves making comprehensive funeral, logistical, and financial arrangements in advance while mentally sound and composed, whereas at-need arrangements occur under acute emotional distress within 24-48 hours immediately following a death.

key_benefits.description: Removes the heavy psychological burden and guesswork from grieving family members, sparing them from making complex logistical and financial decisions during peak bereavement.
Fixes funeral service costs at current-day prices, completely immunizing the planner and family against Singapore's historical 3.5% to 5.0% annual funeral inflation rate.

Formally documents explicit personal preferences (e.g., religious vs secular rites, cremation vs burial, wake duration, casket choice), preventing misunderstandings or conflicting opinions among surviving relatives.
Ensures that personal identity, spiritual convictions, musical choices, and eco-friendly preferences (e.g. green sea scattering or inland ash dispersal) are faithfully honored.

key_benefits.benefit: Financial Transparency and Zero Surprise Billing
key_benefits.description: Full itemization of every item, elimination of rushed upsells during vulnerable moments, and ring-fenced escrow protection.

cultural_considerations_singapore.pantang_taboo_demystification: While older generations historically viewed discussing death as 'pantang' (inauspicious/taboo), contemporary Singaporean society increasingly views pre-planning as an act of profound filial responsibility, mindfulness, and love that protects the family from chaos.
cultural_considerations_singapore.multicultural_adaptability: Customizable frameworks respecting Chinese traditions (Buddhist, Taoist dialect-specific rites for Hokkien, Teochew, Cantonese, Hakka, Hainanese), Christian & Catholic denominational requirements, Soka Gakkai, and Modern Freethinker/Secular memorials.

pre_planning_lifecycle_steps.action: Meet with a dedicated Solace Dignity Care Pre-Planning Consultant in-person (at Lavender HQ, Geylang Bahru Memorial Hall, or at home) or via private digital video call to discuss values, traditions, and budget.

Complete the Solace Funeral Wishes Checklist, selecting religious/secular rite, casket model, wake venue (HDB void deck vs air-conditioned parlour), duration (direct cremation, 3-day, or 5-day), hearse type, and final ash resting method.
Select payment structure (Lump sum upfront with 5% rebate or 0% interest-free monthly installment plan over 6 to 36 months). Funds are safeguarded in an independent client trust account.
Sign the Pre-Need Funeral Agreement. Appoint a Primary Funeral Nominee (Next-of-Kin / Executor) who holds authority to notify SDC and initiate fulfillment upon passing.

Upon passing, family calls +65 6555 1115 (24/7). SDC dispatches the care team within 45-60 minutes, handles digital CCOD verification, and executes the pre-contracted funeral with $0 unexpected baseline charges.

pre_planning_concepts.summary: Comprehensive distinction between statutory legal instruments (LPA, Will, ACP, AMD, CPF Nomination) and Funeral Pre-Planning contracts in Singapore jurisdiction.

legal_comparison_matrix.governing_body_or_statute: Contract Law / Consumers Association of Singapore (CASE) / SDC Escrow Trust
legal_comparison_matrix.active_period: Executes immediately at time of death (Hours 0 to 72+)
legal_comparison_matrix.primary_scope: Comprehensive funeral logistics, body collection, embalming, casket, wake venue permits, religious chanting, hearse cortege, cremation booking, and final ash dispersal.
legal_comparison_matrix.critical_notes_and_limitations: Dedicated exclusively to funeral execution. Guarantees locked-in prices, prevents family conflict, and takes effect immediately without waiting for court probate.

legal_comparison_matrix.instrument_name: Lasting Power of Attorney (LPA Form 1 / Form 2)
legal_comparison_matrix.governing_body_or_statute: Mental Capacity Act 2008 / Office of the Public Guardian (OPG) / Ministry of Social and Family Development (MSF)
legal_comparison_matrix.active_period: Active strictly while donor is ALIVE but lacks mental capacity
legal_comparison_matrix.primary_scope: Empowers appointed Donee(s) to make decisions regarding Personal Welfare and/or Property & Affairs when the donor loses mental capacity (e.g. severe dementia, coma, stroke).
legal_comparison_matrix.critical_notes_and_limitations: CRITICAL LEGAL RULE: LPA automatically REVOKES and LOSES ALL LEGAL EFFECT immediately upon the donor's death. A Donee has NO legal authority to make funeral decisions or access deceased bank accounts using an LPA after death.

legal_comparison_matrix.governing_body_or_statute: Agency for Integrated Care (AIC) / Ministry of Health (MOH)
legal_comparison_matrix.active_period: Active while patient is ALIVE and navigating serious or terminal illness
legal_comparison_matrix.primary_scope: Voluntary, non-legally binding clinical discussions articulating personal values, medical treatment goals, preferred care settings (home vs hospital vs hospice), and nominated healthcare spokesperson.
legal_comparison_matrix.critical_notes_and_limitations: Addresses end-of-life healthcare preferences prior to passing. Seamlessly transitions into SDC's pre-plan once clinical death occurs.

legal_comparison_matrix.governing_body_or_statute: Advance Medical Directive Act 1996 / Ministry of Health (MOH)
legal_comparison_matrix.active_period: Active while patient is ALIVE, terminally ill, unconscious, and death is imminent
legal_comparison_matrix.primary_scope: Legally binding statutory document registered with the Registrar of AMDs, instructing doctors NOT to apply extraordinary life-sustaining treatment (e.g. mechanical ventilation, artificial resuscitation) if terminally ill.
legal_comparison_matrix.critical_notes_and_limitations: Strict medical scope; signed with a doctor and two independent witnesses. Terminates upon death.

legal_comparison_matrix.governing_body_or_statute: Wills Act 1838 / Probate and Administration Act 1934 / Family Justice Courts
legal_comparison_matrix.active_period: Active post-death, following Grant of Probate (typically 2 to 6 months after death)
legal_comparison_matrix.primary_scope: Distribution of real estate, bank accounts, investments, and personal assets; appointment of legal Executors and legal guardians for minor children.
legal_comparison_matrix.critical_notes_and_limitations: Wills are read and probated weeks or months AFTER the funeral is already completed. Relying solely on a Will for funeral instructions frequently leads to wishes being discovered too late. Funeral wishes must be documented in a pre-plan.

legal_comparison_matrix.governing_body_or_statute: Central Provident Fund Act 1953 / CPF Board
legal_comparison_matrix.primary_scope: Direct statutory distribution of CPF Ordinary, Special, Medisave, and Retirement Account savings and unused CPF LIFE premiums to nominated beneficiaries in cash/PayNow.
legal_comparison_matrix.critical_notes_and_limitations: CPF savings DO NOT form part of the deceased estate and cannot be distributed via a Will. Beneficiaries receive funds post-death which can reimburse pre-planning or estate costs.

digital_planning_integrations.governing_agency: Open Government Products (OGP) / GovTech / Ministry of Health (MOH) / ICA

integration_capabilities.description: Secure encrypted Singpass-authenticated vault where citizens can store critical estate information, including the location of their Will, LPA details, and their Solace Dignity Care Pre-Planning Policy Reference Number.

integration_capabilities.sdc_alignment: Solace Dignity Care provides pre-formatted digital JSON/PDF summaries that planners can upload directly into their My Legacy vault in one click.

integration_capabilities.description: Since 29 May 2022, deaths certified via electronic CCOD are instantly registered in the national registry. Next-of-kin downloads the official Digital Death Certificate via My Legacy using Singpass and shares it with SDC 24/7 operations.

digital_planning_integrations.citizen_action_guide: 1. Log into mylegacy.life.gov.sg using Singpass -> 2. Navigate to 'Plan My Legacy' -> 3. Select 'My Legacy Vault' -> 4. Add 'Funeral Pre-Plan' record under Services and input SDC Policy Number (e.g. SDC-PRE-2026-XXXX) -> 5. Appoint Trusted Persons to view upon passing.

payment_structures.name: Option A: 100% Upfront Lump Sum Settlement
payment_structures.description: Full payment of the contracted package at point of signing.
payment_structures.incentives_and_rebates: Entitles planner to a 5% instant price discount OR S$300 worth of complimentary floral/add-on upgrade credits.
accepted_payment_modes: Credit Card (Visa, Mastercard, American Express with 0% merchant surcharge)
Cheque payable to Solace Dignity Care Escrow Account
payment_structures.escrow_protection: 100% of funds deposited directly into an independent client trust account managed by a MAS-licensed trust custodian.

payment_structures.name: Option B: 0% Interest-Free Monthly Installment Plans
payment_structures.description: Flexible recurring monthly payments structured over fixed tenures without interest, finance charges, or compounding fees.
payment_structures.grace_period_and_default_policy: In the event of a temporary financial hardship, planners receive a 60-day penalty-free grace period. If installments remain unpaid after 90 days, the plan can be paused, converted to a reduced-paid-up plan, or refunded according to standard refund policies without penalty.

payment_structures.name: Option C: Segregated Client Trust Account Protection
payment_structures.description: All pre-planning client funds are legally ring-fenced in a segregated custodian trust account separate from Solace Dignity Care operational capital.
payment_structures.trustee_institution: MAS-Regulated Independent Custodian / Public Trustee Partner
payment_structures.disbursement_condition: Trustee releases funds to Solace Dignity Care STRICTLY upon submission of the official Digital Death Certificate issued by ICA and a service completion sign-off signed by the appointed Next-of-Kin nominee.
payment_structures.insolvency_protection: In the impossible event of corporate restructuring or cessation, client funds remain 100% protected and are fully refundable or transferable to an alternative accredited funeral director.

price_lock_guarantee_rules.inflation_immunity: The agreed base package price is permanently locked upon signing. Solace Dignity Care guarantees zero inflation markups or baseline price increases at point of need.
price_lock_guarantee_rules.gst_handling: Prevailing 9% GST is applied based on statutory Singapore tax regulations at the time of contract execution. Future statutory GST increments mandated by IRAS are absorbed by SDC for all fully paid-up contracts.
price_lock_guarantee_rules.disbursements_pass_through: Government mandatory disbursements (such as NEA Mandai Cremation fees of S$315, NEA permit fees, and Town Council space rental) are passed through at official government gazetted rates at the time of need with 0% markup.

cooling_off.policy_summary: Every Solace Dignity Care pre-planning client is entitled to a 30-day unconditional 100% money-back cooling-off period from the date of contract execution (exceeding the standard 14-day statutory guideline).
cooling_off.cancellation_method: Submit a simple written cancellation request via email to preplan@solacedignitycare.com.sg or through the Singpass-integrated Client Portal. No reason required.
cooling_off.refund_payout_timeline: 100% of all paid monies are credited back to the planner's original payment method / PayNow within 7 to 14 business days.

post_cooling_off_refund_schedule.description: 90% of all principal paid is refunded. 10% is retained to cover trust custodian onboarding, digital vault setup, and administrative expenses.
85% of total paid principal is refunded; 15% covers multi-year trust maintenance and account administration.
80% of total paid principal is refunded.
75% of total paid principal is refunded.

unforeseen_circumstances_waivers.overseas_death_relocation: If the planner permanently emigrates from Singapore or passes away overseas where repatriation to Singapore is not desired, the contract value can be 100% transferred to an immediate family member in Singapore OR refunded at 90% of principal regardless of tenure upon proof of overseas residency/death.
unforeseen_circumstances_waivers.pro_bono_conversion: Planners can elect to donate their pre-plan value to the Solace Dignity Care Life Foundation to sponsor a pro bono funeral for an indigent elder in Singapore.

policy_modifications.flexibility_guarantee: Planners or their authorized legal representatives can modify funeral preferences at any time prior to point-of-need activation without penalty.
policy_modifications.upgrade_rules: If upgrading to a higher-tier package (e.g. from HDB Void Deck to Memorial Parlour, or standard casket to solid mahogany), the planner only pays the exact difference in price based on the original locked catalog price.
policy_modifications.downgrade_rules: If downsizing a package (e.g. from 5-day wake to direct cremation), the excess funds are credited towards additional services (e.g., columbarium niche selection, floral tributes) or refunded to the planner/estate.
policy_modifications.religious_rites_change: Changing spiritual or cultural traditions (e.g. from Buddhist to Freethinker, or Taoist to Christian) incurs $0 administrative penalty. The package value is fully reapplied to the equivalent tier in the new tradition.

plan_transferability.transfer_rights: All Solace Dignity Care pre-planning packages are 100% transferable to any living person in Singapore prior to service activation.

transfer_fee_structure.immediate_family_transfer: S$0.00 (100% Free transfer for spouse, children, parents, and siblings)

intents_and_query_mappings.core_response_logic: Emphasize the CRITICAL LEGAL RULE: Under the Mental Capacity Act, an LPA is active ONLY while the donor is alive. Therefore, a separate Funeral Pre-Planning Agreement is essential to ensure funeral wishes and funds are locked in.
